Each case is the text emitted since the previous prompt, plus the room name the trailing room_data carried. renderStart is the index where the room render begins, or -1 when the window holds no render. Cases with renderStart > 0 are the regression this fixture exists for: a render preceded by other output (portal echoes, wake-up, escape flavor, interleaved chat), which is 15.7% of all real renders and which a first-line anchor silently missed.

lines: The Library of Storm Keep
Past two tall doors of rich dark wood is a room of great proportions.
Each of its four expansive walls, made of black marble, are lined with
polished wooden shelves that hold countless tomes, books, and scrolls,
extending far up along the wall.  Several ladders lean against these
shelves, providing aid in retrieving items from normally inaccessible
heights.  An oval table made of some dark material occupies the center of
the room, with a number high-backed chairs surrounding it.  On this table
are several books, some open, some stacked one on top another, as well as a
candle in which to read by.  Another source of illumination comes from a
simple iron chandelier, set with eight tapered candles, hanging a few feet
above the table from a chain lost in the shadows of the black ceiling above.
A carpet of rich crimson covers the entire floor, muffling footsteps and
echoes, contributing to the quiet and relaxed atmosphere of the room.  The
office of the Chamber of Mysticism lies to the southwest, the office of the
Chamber of Theology to the southeast.
[Exits: south  ]
Wooden bookshelves filled with tomes line the walls of the room.
A wide circular table heaped with books fills the center of the room
A Darkened Hallway
The black, marble corridor you follow leads deeper into the bowels of
Storm Keep.  There exists no source of terrestrial illumination, for no
windows are present to betray the darkness.  Instead, a row of flickering
torches lines either side of the hall, causing the shadows around you to
come to life.
[Exits: north east south west  ]
Chamber of Rest
This dome-shaped room is immense, the ceiling rising high up into the
air, surpassing any other point of Storm Keep.  Constructed of a highly
polished black marble, it is lit by numerous crystal chandeliers that hang
from chains constructed of interwoven strands of gold and silver.  They are
the only source of light in this room; like the rest of the keep, there are
no windows present.  Numerous blankets are spread out across the marble
floor in a systematic and orderly fashion of linear ranks and files.  They
are well padded, and each has a soft, down pillow placed at its head.  Along
the eastern wall, numerous shelves stretch across the expanse of the
chamber, filled with trophies, armors, and weapons claimed in honorable
combat from fallen foes.  A narrow spiral staircase leads to a dark chamber
below.
Framing the entrance, a beautiful arbor stands in magnificence, a
complimenting display of dark green against the dark marbled stone.  Within
the leafy recess, deep purple roses bloom, their swirling centers almost as
black as the wickedly sharp thorns that circle in protection of each one.
A single, long-stemmed rose has been carefully placed on each padded bed,
with a small black tag attached.
[Exits: south west down  ]
(Glowing) A glowing orb is suspended here, the occasional spark shooting out from the sphere.
Numerous blankets line the marble floor, inviting you to rest for as long as necessary.
A black marble fountain trickles quietly with water here.
(White Aura) Storm's healing priest sits upon a gray blanket near the rooms center, in quiet contemplation.
The Treasury of Storm Keep
Granting entrance into this chamber at the heart of the Keep, two
enormous, iron-bound doors are swung wide and chained open, their prodigious
weight proof that they are very rarely closed.  Along the southern wall is
an enormous rack of arms, swords, axes, maces, and then more elaborate
weapons progressing from left to right.  The northern wall is similar, lined
with suits of armor, from plate and chain to the right towards robes and
capes and clothing to the far corner.  More suits of armor with shield and
weapons are scattered on racks throughout the room.  Each suit is menacing
and befitting a Shadow Knight, and it is these suits which give rise to the
total lack of security for they are widely bruited to animate themselves and
attack any who would claim items he did not personally deposit.
Aisles of tables hold coffers and cabinets of Storm Keep's possessions.
Each Knight appears to have a carefully labelled section, some locked and
some not.  Some of the coffers and armors themselves emit light whether from
innate enchantment or various security measures, one can only guess.  The
final noticable feature of the room is the enormous vault door in the wall
immediately across from the entrance.  It is here that monies and treasures
of the greatest value are deposited.  Immediately aside the door, a small
golden plaque can be seen set into the stone.
[Exits: north east  ]
A long black duster made with many pockets is here.
( 5) An iron-cast cannonball is rolling around here.
The door of the mystic vault is here in the wall.
You enter a dark glowing orb.
Common Room of Eclipse Tower
The ancient stone staircase leads into the extensive common room.  The
grand stature of the architecture is breathtaking an idyllic blending of
archaic granite stone and modern crafted furniture.  Blackened iron sconces
adorn the outskirts, radiating crimson light to the vaulted spire of the
Tower.  The flames illuminate several prominent, cascading banners, the
blackened flag of Storm Keep and the blood red, time-worn banner of Eclipse,
hanging from the ceiling.  Along the far wall a row of simple cots invite
the weary knight to take some respite.  Beside the cots stands a wooden
bookshelf brimming with countless tomes, both old and new.  A circular table
sits in the center of the room, with several dusty tomes still laying open
upon it.  Embrasures are carved into the granite at various strategic
points, allowing for defensive cannons and archers.  The sheer height of the
tower offers excellent views of Verminasia, the Ebony Spire, and the Altar
of Darkness.
[Exits: down  ]
(Glowing) A voidiron mirror embedded in the tower's wall crackles with distortions of umbra.
(Glowing) A dark orb hovers in the air, shadows swirling about the sphere.
A black demonic skull trickles quietly with water here.
A row of simple cots awaiting occupants.
A wide circular table sits in the center of the room.
(White Aura) A Nightwarden of Drakkara tends to the Eclipse Tower, chanting softly.

lines: You enter a portal to Shadow Clan Hall.
At the Base of a Black, Marble Staircase
The staircase ends at a rectangular shaped room constructed of the same
black marble as the rest of the keep.  The walls, however, are inscribed
with numerous sigils and runes, surrounded on all sides by phrases and
dialects of an unknown nature.  They run laterally and vertically across the
stone and pulse with a dim glow.  The room itself is filled with a soft
humming sound that echoes off the stone and sweeps over you like an ocean
breeze.  At the far end of the room, the wall shimmers with a transparent
light through which you are able to make out shapes and shadows.  Through
closer inspection, you might discover what lies on the other side.
A small bronze plaque is mounted to the eastern wall.
[Exits: up  ]
(Glowing) (Humming) A portal glows brightly here.
You step through a gate and vanish.
Guillotine Road
You are on the west end of Guillotine Road. To the west is the tower city
gates. Eastward Guillotine Road continues. A small shop to the north has
no name and looks oddly different from the busy stores on the rest of the
street. To the south is a potion and herbal shop. Looking farther east, you
see a large Guillotine overshadowing a town square.
[Exits: north east south west  ]
(Red Aura) A street cleaner is busy picking up trash.
You enter an umbral corridor.
Darkmoor Ascent
An oval of dusklight refracts like fractured glass beyond the darkmoor,
and vague impressionist shapes drift in transit between the Eclipsian Tower
and the destination beyond.  Shadowed limbs and trunk-like figures coalesce
and fade, the ground beneath both firm and yielding, lending an impression
of travel along a rutted road through a timeless forest.  A cascade of umbra
flows above and around the aperture of the passage as it narrows,
silhouettes of humanoid shades, phantasmic beasts, and shapeless planeforms
probing at the bounds of the tunnel's weave.  The vastness of the umbra
stretches away in all directions and a black arch in the shape of a lunar
crescent marks the mooring's exit.
[Exits: up  ]
(Red Aura) (Glowing) An oval of fractured dusklight hovers before the darkmoor's passage.
You enter the darkmoor passage.

(Translucent) (Red Aura) Ezrianne is sitting here.

You feel a burst of energy.

You have become better at pugil!
You disappear into the void.
You stop using the staff of the Blind Prince.
You wield a grand arcanium hoopak.
A grand arcanium hoopak feels like a part of you!
You are thirsty.
You are hungry.
You drink water from a decanter of endless water.
